CAPITAL MARKET ADVISORY

Services / Investment Banking / Capital Markets Advisory
Capital Markets Advisory

– Equity Capital Markets
– Debt Capital Markets
– Capital Restructuring
– Corporate Broking

Arqaam provides a broad range Capital Markets advisory and arranging services, including:

Equity Capital markets

Advising on equity, equity-linked and equity derivative solutions

Transactions include initial public offerings (IPO), follow-on offerings, rights issues, pre-IPO equity raises, convertible bonds, private placements and secondary placings

Debt Capital Markets

Advising on public and private placement of a variety of debt instruments

Transactions include primary issuance of bonds, sukuks, perpetual bonds and structured debt

Capital Restructuring

Advising on available capital structures and restructuring of existing debt

Transactions include equity or debt capital raising, conversion of debt to equity and cash flow management

Corporate Broking

Advising listed companies on their relationship and dialogue with investors and the market

Acting as an interface between the company and the market

 

Provided services in relation to the foregoing include:

Business, financial and transaction feasibility analysis

Advice on selection of listing exchange, timing, structure and terms of a transaction

Recommendation on selection of legal and other professional advisers

Assistance with drafting marketing material and offering memoranda

Identification of potential investors and bookbuilding

Support and assistance in relation to investor roadshows

Coordinating and leading the syndicate of financial institutions involved in the transaction
